description: On the red bedspread in front of you are several small toys and objects, including a blue plate, a yellow block, a white figurine, a small domino tile, a blue star piece, a pink duck, and a teal glasses case. The right hand reaches in from the right, moves toward the white figurine, grips it as the right-hand object, lifts it up and carries it rightward over the bed, then lowers and releases it onto the blue plate.
